description: Role deletion: refused while users hold it and for built-in roles.

cases.log: Audit row RoleDeleted (details { name, capabilities: ["MeetingCreator"] }); log "Role {RoleId} deleted by {ActorId}."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Custom role "Thư ký phó" with capabilities [MeetingCreator]; no account holds it, active or deactivated.
cases.return: RoleResult Success (MSG23); the role and its capability grants are removed.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Custom role held by 2 active accounts.
cases.return: RoleResult InUse with userCount 2 (MSG25); nothing deleted.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Custom role held by exactly 1 account, which is deactivated.
cases.return: RoleResult InUse with userCount 1 (MSG25): deactivated accounts still count.

cases.log: Log "Deleting role {RoleId} refused by the foreign key: {Count} account(s) hold it."
preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
The role has no holder when counted, but an account is assigned to it before the delete executes (the foreign key refuses the delete).
cases.return: RoleResult InUse (MSG25) with the fresh count, at least 1; no audit row.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
The database fails while deleting (connection lost or timeout).
cases.return: RoleResult Failure(SaveFailed) (MSG28); the role and its grants remain.

preconditions: Actor is an administrator holding AdminUsers.
Custom role with no capabilities and no holders.
cases.return: RoleResult Success (MSG23); audit details list capabilities as an empty array.
